summary: Tested the new admin « Connecteurs » dashboard: backend endpoint GET /api/admin/connectors + frontend tab in /admin. Created /app/backend/tests/test_admin_connectors.py with 7 tests covering (1) auth: missing password → 401/403, wrong password → 401/403, (2) response shape: {backlog:[], supported:[]} with correct per-row keys (connector, blocked, companies, members, examples, offers_30d, difficulty, score, priority for backlog; kind, label, companies, members, fetched, matched, success_pct, fallback, blocked for supported), (3) business rules: blocked rows always have priority='Aucune (protection)', success_pct in [0,100] or null, (4) sort ordering: backlog sorted by score desc, supported sorted by companies desc. 7/7 passed. Frontend verified on preview URL (/admin → login admin2026 → Connecteurs tab): admin-connectors panel renders with both connectors-backlog and connectors-supported sections. Backlog is currently empty (connectors-backlog-empty text 'Aucun portail non pris en charge détecté pour l'instant' displayed — expected in preview since no member has logged a non-pris-en-charge company yet). Supported connectors shows 5 live rows: Workday (4 entreprises / 18 membres / 120 offres lues / 120 retenues / 100 % / 0 repli), amazon.jobs (1/6/78/78/100 %/0), Oracle Recruiting (1/1/2/2/100 %/0), SmartRecruiters (1/1/28/28/100 %/0), SuccessFactors (1/1/0/0/0 %/1 repli Jooble) — SuccessFactors low success is correctly highlighted in amber. Sort order and all data-testid attributes (admin-tab-connectors, admin-connectors, connectors-backlog, connectors-supported, connectors-backlog-empty, connector-active-{kind}, connector-row-{slug}) are present. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/careeros/connectors.py (78 lines) is clean and well-scoped: single endpoint, async Mongo iteration, no _id leakage, admin-gated via injected check_admin, no hardcoded secrets. Good.

DIFFICULTY table hardcodes known ATS → labels/weights; unknown ATS falls back to ('À évaluer', 0.5) which is sensible. Priority bucketing (>=66% of top → Élevée, >=33% → Moyenne) is simple and deterministic.
The Jooble 30-day aggregation uses an ISO string compare against first_seen — relies on first_seen being stored as ISO strings. Current data confirms this works, just worth noting.
Supported connectors derive stats from last run per member via an aggregation pipeline — this correctly reflects the member's most recent portal reads without inflating historical data.
Frontend Connectors.jsx (49 lines) has proper data-testid coverage, loading state (Loader2), error toast, and empty-state message. No issues.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Connecteurs tab renders, both panels visible, 5 active connectors, empty-backlog state shown correctly)
